baselinePolicy: The C0 merge commit on main is the immutable rc.1 source baseline. Any source, content, dependency, schema, or deployment-behavior change after that commit creates a new rc.N candidate and invalidates affected certification evidence.
invalidationReason: C4 found that viewport-fit=cover was enabled while only horizontal safe-area insets were applied globally, leaving top and bottom installed-mobile UI vulnerable to display cutouts and the home-indicator region.
